'''Mambo Farls''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as a designer on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Farls was married to [[Gelly Farls]] and worked for [[Uniformal Attire]], a company that designed and produced corporate Uniforms. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], he was tasked with developing a new uniform for security staff at the company [[Culpharm]]. He spent two and a half months working on the project, eventually developing a distinct green-and-gold-colored uniform. However, he discussed the project with his wife and she took some of the uniforms and gave them to [[Biotherapy]], a rival of Culpharm.

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Farls was a very bouncy and enthusiastic person.
